details: Evaluated 676 entity IDs across Users, Requisitions, Candidates, and Applications.

Checked range constraints on salaries, experiences, and interview timelines across 110 records.

Detected 8 applications advanced to Offer without an Offer stage-history review.

Validated completeness across 105 evaluation scorecards; all 5 dimensions scored 1-5.
Verified weighted score formula SUM(crit*weight)/5*100 across 105 scorecards.
Verified all accepted offers have corresponding approved signatures.
Evaluated 250 candidate emails with zero duplicates detected.
Deterministic pseudo-random state verified against seed 20261022.
